exposure: perceived support from nurses immediately postpartum (finding nurses helpful)
cohort: Mothers (n=169) recruited from two community clinics in Soweto, South Africa, within the first few days following delivery.
finding: Finding nurses 'always' helpful resulted in a 14% greater likelihood of exclusively breastfeeding, but this effect was not mediated via breastfeeding self-efficacy.
cross-section timing: Data was collected within the first few days following delivery, with most collected within 4 days of birth (IQR: 3-7 days) and 10% after 12 days.
